title: Verify creating an application requires company name
preconditions: The application is running and an authenticated API client is available
steps: Send POST /api/v1/applications with an otherwise valid application payload that omits company_name
expected_result: The response status is 422. The error code is VALIDATION_ERROR, error details are present, and the first detail identifies company_name as missing.

title: Verify creating an application rejects an invalid status
preconditions: The application is running and an authenticated API client is available
steps: Send POST /api/v1/applications with an otherwise valid payload and status invalid_status
expected_result: The response status is 422. The error code is VALIDATION_ERROR, error details are present, and the first detail identifies status with an enum validation error.

title: Verify retrieving a nonexistent application returns not found
preconditions: The application is running and an authenticated API client is available
expected_result: The response status is 404 and the error response has code NOT_FOUND and message Application not found.

title: Verify the application list requires authentication
preconditions: The application is running and no authentication is provided
steps: Send GET /api/v1/applications with an unauthenticated API client
expected_result: The response status is 401 and the error response has code AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED and message Authentication required.
